```artifact
Feature: User Information and Appointment Management

  Scenario: Admin updates doctors information
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin clicks on "Doctors" in the sidebar
    And the admin selects a doctor to update
    And the admin enters new information for the doctor
    And the admin clicks on "Update"
    Then the doctor's information should be updated in the system

  Scenario: Admin updates labs and Chemist information
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin clicks on "Labs and Chemists" in the sidebar
    And the admin selects a lab or chemist to update
    And the admin enters new information for the lab or chemist
    And the admin clicks on "Update"
    Then the lab or chemist's information should be updated in the system

  Scenario: Patient updates personal details
    Given a patient is logged in
    When the patient clicks on "Profile" in the sidebar
    And the patient enters new personal details
    And the patient clicks on "Update"
    Then the patient's personal details should be updated in the system

  Scenario: Patient creates an appointment
    Given a patient is logged in
    When the patient clicks on "Appointments" in the sidebar
    And the patient selects a doctor
    And the patient enters the appointment date and time
    And the patient clicks on "Create Appointment"
    Then an appointment should be created and displayed in the appointments tab

  Scenario Outline: Admin updates doctors information with invalid data
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin clicks on "Doctors" in the sidebar
    And the admin selects a doctor to update
    And the admin enters <invalid_data> for the doctor
    And the admin clicks on "Update"
    Then an error message should be displayed

    Examples:
      | invalid_data |
      | ""           |
      | "12345"      |
      | "Invalid Name" |

  Scenario Outline: Admin updates labs and Chemist information with invalid data
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin clicks on "Labs and Chemists" in the sidebar
    And the admin selects a lab or chemist to update
    And the admin enters <invalid_data> for the lab or chemist
    And the admin clicks on "Update"
    Then an error message should be displayed

    Examples:
      | invalid_data |
      | ""           |
      | "12345"      |
      | "Invalid Name" |

  Scenario Outline: Patient updates personal details with invalid data
    Given a patient is logged in
    When the patient clicks on "Profile" in the sidebar
    And the patient enters <invalid_data> for the personal details
    And the patient clicks on "Update"
    Then an error message should be displayed

    Examples:
      | invalid_data |
      | ""           |
      | "12345"      |
      | "Invalid Email" |

  Scenario Outline: Patient creates an appointment with invalid date and time
    Given a patient is logged in
    When the patient clicks on "Appointments" in the sidebar
    And the patient selects a doctor
    And the patient enters <invalid_date_time> for the appointment date and time
    And the patient clicks on "Create Appointment"
    Then an error message should be displayed

    Examples:
      | invalid_date_time |
      | "2020-01-01"    |
      | "2020-13-01"    |
      | "2020-01-32"    |
      | "2020-01-01 25:00" |
```
